chapter: After Oliver: Chicago and New York
title: Being typecast as a first-chair reader, not a Dixieland soloist
summary: He says people always put him on first trumpet because he reads, which loses him chances to play Dixieland; he prefers small bands and jam sessions.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: you see the way the guys you see the thing about it what made it like I had a discussion like that after the red arrow everyone knew I could read and play trumpet so the first thing they would do they would put me in a band and get me to take hold now either the first trumpet chair or like when I was a concert because I played the third trumpet chair because that was all the high parts you know the whole thing like that well next thing you see there's no need to you holding down some horn chairs and then taking all them swing solos too you see see so that would make it but I had to the person who didn't know that's lost track of me as a Dixieland man you see like right now if I'd go back now the first thing they would me do was get in a band and we'll take them to play first trumpet or solo trumpet I'd take them to play all them well I can't take them to play those Dixieland well I'd rather take them to play the Dixieland boys because you know what they call second swing boys but the first thing I want you to do is play first because that's what you're short of you don't have those men and see when you get in a large band that come I don't like no large band I play in a large band but I like a small band so when you get in a large band when you've got those five and six and seven braids then the first thing they're going to do is say well Bobby you've got the first you've got the hold down to the braids but then by doing all that play I don't get a chance to take and roll my horn like I want to do because I'm playing straight to notes and everything like that and that's what made you lose track of my songs but then we would have jam sessions and that's when the fellas in the band we would have to do just notes down in the small paradise we had those jam sessions all the time down there
